name: NCI Genomic Data Commons API

provider.name: National Cancer Institute, Genomic Data Commons

summary: Cancer genomics metadata and open-access data: projects, cases, files, genes, somatic mutations (TCGA, TARGET and more).
description: The GDC API exposes the GDC data model as JSON search endpoints (projects, cases, files, annotations) plus gene, simple somatic mutation (SSM) and copy-number-variation endpoints. Open-access files can be downloaded via the data endpoint without a token; controlled-access data needs an NIH token. A projects query on 2026-11-11 reported 93 projects.

auth.notes: No credential needed for metadata and open-access data; controlled-access files need a dbGaP-authorised token in the X-Auth-Token header (not tested).

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in the pages fetched; fair use.

endpoints.summary: List or filter projects (programs such as TCGA, TARGET)
Search cases (patients) with clinical and demographic fields
Search data files and their metadata
Service status and current data release

example.response_excerpt: {"data": {"hits": [{"id": "ALCHEMIST-ALCH", "primary_site": ["Not Reported"], "project_id": "ALCHEMIST-ALCH", "name": "Adjuvant Lung Cancer Enrichment Marker Identification and Sequencing Trial"}, {"id": "APOLLO-BRCA-1", "primary_site": ["Breast"], "project_id": "APOLLO-BRCA-1", "name": "Proteogenomic analysis of tumors from young women with breast cancer"}], "pagination": {"count": 2, "total": 93, "size": 2, "from": 0, "sort": "None", "page": 1, "pages": 47}}, "warnings": {}}

license.name: Open-access data is freely usable; controlled-access data needs authorisation (terms not re-confirmed)

coverage.geographic: Global patient cohorts, mostly US programs

agent_notes: Use the fields parameter to keep responses small and the filters parameter (JSON, URL-encoded) for queries; size and from page results, pagination is in the response. Ids are UUIDs for cases and files, symbolic ids for projects (TCGA-LUAD). /status returns the data release. Open files download from /data/{file_id}.
caveats: Filter syntax is a JSON expression language ({"op":"in","content":{"field":..,"value":[..]}}) that must be URL-encoded; it is easier to start with simple field queries.
Only metadata and open-access files were checked; controlled-access downloads need an NIH token.
CORS reflected the sent origin on the example; other endpoints not checked.
License terms were not stated on the pages fetched; check GDC data use policy before redistributing.
